name: context-milvus
description: Semantic code search for Codex backed by a Milvus vector database

interface.shortDescription: Semantic code search over your repository
interface.longDescription: Indexes the repository into Milvus with AST-aware chunking, then answers natural-language code queries. Provides search_code, index_code, index_status, find_callers and trace_call_chain over MCP.
